$comment: Copy to src/data/nav.json. brand.name defaults to site.json siteName. Leave brand.logo empty for a wordmark-only header; logos are SVG masters with explicit width/height. items: label + href, optional external (auto-detected for absolute URLs) and one level of children [{label, href, description?}]. A parent without href renders as a submenu button only. cta is optional. Example children shape: { "label": "Services", "href": "/services/", "children": [{ "label": "Design", "href": "/services/design/", "description": "One line." }] }. The shipped items only link routes a fresh site has (Home, About, Contact) so the first build has no dead links; add sections as you create the pages.
